content.comment_body: Hello, I have a question. I purchased a [product_name], and when I tried sending a message to activate Q1, diagnostics reported that my number was not authorized. My phone number is listed as an administrator in the user settings. Can anyone assist with this?

Hi [user_name], Normally, if the number is entered correctly, it works with the [product_name]. Here are some steps to check: - Is your number enabled for SMS reception, not just listed? - Are you able to send an SMS to the configured number? - Try using wildcards, for example: entering the phone number as 0123* will allow any number beginning with 0123 (e.g., 012345678 or 0123999999). - Does it work if you authorize all numbers? Best regards

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing problems with phone number authorization for SMS control on the [product_name]. Even when the phone number is set as an administrator, the device fails to recognize it as authorized, resulting in unsuccessful actions. The discussion highlights confusion over device authorization settings, particularly regarding specific number input and wildcard usage.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate that simply configuring their phone number as an administrator should permit SMS-based control operations without additional setup.
